content:
anya: Heads-up — we need cross-team alignment for the Q2 launch lane (Adaptive Serving 1.0). Major deps: runtime batching/quant, infra capacity & autoscale rules, security telemetry/DSR, and product acceptance criteria. Can teams confirm blockers and rough lead times? @ryan @sanjay @kevin :wave:

ryan: Runtime note — quant + perf bench is the gating item from our side. If we can freeze model size, we can do a 2-week sprint to get 4-bit quantization and KV-cache perf tests. Need clarity on target_seq and sample traffic. Suggested config: `target_seq=1024, quant=4bit`

sanjay: Infra — we can reserve capacity (2x A10s per shard) but need a commitment by EOD Fri for capacity provisioning. Also need the autoscale metrics defined: `requests_per_sec` and `cold_start_latency` thresholds. Without commit, no guaranteed prewarm slots :eyes:

kevin: Security — privacy review required for telemetry flow. We need a DSR checklist filled + KMS plan for logs before any beta. Which telemetry fields are essential? If we can limit to aggregated metrics we can avoid SRE-level audits.

matt: Product acceptance criteria proposal: 95p latency <300ms, 99p <800ms at 80% sustained load; quality regression checks across 5 prompt families (sanity + regression harness). If security requires DSR/KMS changes that add 1 week, product can accept 7-day logs retention for beta to unblock.

anya: Quick ask: can each team state a blocking item (yes/no) + best ETA for removing it? I want a compact checklist before the handshake. Proposed handshake: tomorrow 10:30am PST, 30m. Agenda: commit, perf prereqs, rollout gates. If you can’t make, drop notes here. :calendar:

ryan: Blockers: model freeze (yes). ETA to remove blocker: 2w after freeze. Also need infra to confirm shard count and prewarm plan.

sanjay: Blockers: capacity commit (yes). ETA: need confirmation by Fri, then 3 business days to provision and verify prewarm test.

kevin: Blockers: DSR/KMS plan (partial). ETA: I can approve an aggregated telemetry plan in 3 business days; full DSR+KMS plan ~10 business days.

matt: Blockers: none from product if infra + runtime hit the SLAs. ETA: we’ll lock acceptance tests by EOD Thu.

anya: Cool. I’ll create the 30m invite and add a short pre-read (benchmarks + acceptance matrix). If you already have notes, paste them here.

calendar-bot: Event created — "Adaptive Serving 1.0 handshake" 2026-03-22 10:30 PST.

ryan: Also — can you share expected traffic baseline? we need target RPS + p95 payload size to size batchers.

matt: Target baseline: 250 RPS sustained, p95 payload ~750 tokens. Peak burst plan: 750 RPS for 30s bursts.

anya: Thanks — putting these into the pre-read. See you all tomorrow. :thumbsup:
